name: Colorado
summary_text: CADA expressly covers gender identity and expression in employment, housing and public accommodation — the last is directly traveler-relevant (hotels, restaurants, venues) — expanded again in 2025. Most Protective tier. Clearly above the national score 0.36.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (403); the underlying source is the Colorado Legislature's 2025 summary of gender-affirming-care and transgender legislation (r25-595), documenting that CADA's non-discrimination coverage — employment, housing and public accommodations, expressly including gender identity and gender expression — was expanded again in 2025.

sources.title: Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026
sources.claim_summary: Anti-trans national legal-risk assessment map, July 2026 edition (Erin In The Morning): rates every state's legislative posture toward transgender people; the update made Idaho the fourth "Do Not Travel" state and raised South Carolina to "Worst Laws Passed," while placing Colorado in the Most Protective tier of states with non-discrimination and shield/refuge coverage.
